verdict.rationale: Mangopay provides an OpenAPI spec (mangopay-probe-2) and a Sandbox API you can call to explore features (mangopay-docs-2), plus SDKs and test cards for simulating calls (mangopay-docs-27), suggesting some interactive/testable API surface. However there's no explicit evidence of a browser-based 'try-it-out' console or embedded runnable code examples in the docs themselves. Missing for 10: explicit interactive API reference UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc try-it widget), documented runnable code snippets embedded in docs, independent confirmation of an interactive playground.
